summary: rec.gov: fees 14-22 -> 18-26 (2026 table); count 56 -> 55 family sites (group excluded; description says 78 family sites, 45 with hookups); 50 A + water, 7 pull-throughs, max 55; flush/vault/showers/dump; 14-night max, 3-night holiday minimum. Waterfront lakeview -> LAKEFRONT proposed (C loop, official photos).
flags: WATERFRONT (apply.py does not write it): stored lakeview -> propose LAKEFRONT. Official rec.gov photos of C02, C04, C05 and C07 show each pad ending at open mown grass with only scattered trees and the lake directly beyond; imagery puts C01-C07 ~35-60 m from the SW shoreline with no road, driveway or day use between (the pads are spurs pointing at the shore off the outside of the loop road). These are the non-electric sites, RV 40-45 ft, so EKKO fits. Electric sites: D01-D07 (pull-through) ~50-80 m back through open trees, lake visible in the D05 photo = lakeview; E01-E09 (non-electric) lakeview through trees (E02 photo); loop A (A01-A32, all the 50 A sites) is ~150-300 m inland with no water in view (A08 photo). Suggested waterfront_evidence: 'rec.gov photos C02/C04/C05/C07: lake directly beyond open grass; Esri 2026-11-06 with rec.gov coords: C loop ~35-60 m to the shore, no road/day use between; electric sites D/E lakeview, A inland.'

SITES: the rec.gov description says '78 family campsites, 45 of which have hookups', but the catalog lists 55 family sites (39 electric + 16 non-electric) plus one group site; written 55 from the catalog. The ~23 others may be unlisted first-come sites; unconfirmed.
SEASON not written: only the rate season (05-01..09-14) is published, which is not a campground season.
